summary: 1951 100-foot Aermotor MC-39 fire tower in Choctaw County, Alabama, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission and NHLR-registered in 2010; little else documented.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor MC-39 tower with 7 by 7 foot cab

events.note: Constructed in 1951 per the register; a local blog gives the same year
Registered January 18, 2010 as US 869, AL 47; nominated by Thomas Kaufmann

evidence.quote: The Womack Hill Lookout Tower is a 100' Aermotor MC-39 with a 7'x7' cab.

evidence.supports: administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission
also known as Daniels Fire Tower on some maps
evidence.quote: Womack Hill Tower is also known as Daniels Fire Tower on some maps.
Womack Hill Tower was built in 1951

evidence.supports: blog lists the state number as AL 48

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Both sources give US 869. The register gives AL 47 and the blog gives AL 48. We keep the register's own figure, since the blog is secondary.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register and one local blog agree on the 1951 build year and the MC-39 design. The Forest Lookouts Womack Hill page (easternuslookouts.weebly.com/womack-hill.html) has a header only (Choctaw County, Alabama Forestry Commission) and is not cited. The blog says some maps call the tower the Daniels Fire Tower; the record's other_names is empty, so an editor may want to add that after checking maps. The blog's AL 48 disagrees with the register's AL 47. No readable source on staffing, fire history, access or current condition. Search snippets for a YouTube short and a Facebook reel describe the tower as still standing; those pages were not readable, so they are not used. The blog also links a Rumble video, which was not read. No photos added.
